decisions.reason: As a close extension of the existing catalog that was given its own page for two years, management is likely to justify the initial investment and keep it unless demand has clearly exhausted itself.
Because this illustrated release series builds on the firm's established strengths and signals a visible category commitment, escalation of commitment makes continued support more likely.
A reissued jazz vinyl LP fits the firm's reissue expertise, collector audience, and stated genre-and-format broadening, so management would be inclined to persist with it.
The multi-disc box set suits the firm's specialist physical-media positioning and likely involved meaningful sunk costs, which encourages management to continue rather than retreat quickly.

With only limited visibility on the website and a less distinctive commitment than the other launches, this compilation CD is the easiest product for management to remove despite some tendency to persist.
